formation: Phonosemantic compound. 殳 represents the meaning and 凡 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "tray", now written as 盤/槃. The current meaning is a phonetic loan. The original 凡 component was later corrupted to 舟 (boat).

components.note: Pictograph of a tray. Later corrupted to 舟.
Depicts a hand holding a weapon or utensil.
